description.value: Datang Hot Pot is a modern Chinese restaurant in Richmond specializing in build-your-own mala tang and dry pot, with broths made fresh daily. The spacious dine-in setting features a wide sauce bar, buffet ice cream, and snacks like roujiamo and skewers. Customer reviews highlight generous portions and friendly service, making it a notable stop for a substantial hot meal.
